description: Deletes a note (comment) from an issue in a GitLab project. Use this action when you need to remove a specific comment from an issue. This action is irreversible — the note cannot be recovered once deleted.

id.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.
id.title: Id

issue_iid.description: The internal ID of the issue.
issue_iid.title: Issue Iid

note_id.description: The ID of the note to delete.
note_id.title: Note Id

name: delete_issue_note

message.description: A message indicating the status of the deletion.
message.title: Message

status_code.description: HTTP status code of the response.
status_code.title: Status Code
